task.description:
Run all PD-09 tests and produce a structured test report.

### Commands to run

```bash
zig build test
zig build test-integration   # requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL
```

All tests must pass (integration tests may be skipped if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is not set — document this). If any non-infrastructure test fails, report FAIL with full error output in `result.issues`.

### Report location

Write the test run report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd09-20260521-run-01.md`.

Report format (use the same format as `tests/reports/` most recent report):
- Run ID, date, requirement IDs tested
- Summary table: test name | result | duration
- Full output for any failing tests
- Infrastructure skip notes (BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set)
- Pass/fail verdict

### Acceptance gate

All TC-PD-09-01 through TC-PD-09-07 must PASS (or SKIP with documented infrastructure reason). Any non-infrastructure failure must be reported in `result.issues` with severity, test name, and error output.

`zig build test` must exit 0. `zig build test-integration` must exit 0 (skips acceptable).
acceptance_criteria: All TC-PD-09-01 through TC-PD-09-07 pass or are skipped with BPM_TEST_DB_URL documentation
zig build test-integration exits 0 (skips acceptable if BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set)
result.status is PASS only if all non-infrastructure tests pass
